Text description of the board

A LITTLE CAUSE. A LITTLE EFFECT.

Route three differently shaped loads through a low ground arch or an open trench, keeping the entire cargo envelope clear.

Time advances only when you act. Take a breath and plan the next move.

Field notes
Deliver three loads from ground-aisle docks. Hanging lamps extend 1 unit below the deck; stacked crates extend 1 above; long pendulums extend 2 below. Inspect all orders in the board description before collecting. Transfer needs the exact dock column and height, with sway at most 1.
In the ground aisle, the load bottom must stay at height 1 or higher. Ceilings are at height 3 in columns 4–6 and height 4 in column 7. Over the open trench, wheels run along the edges and cargo may hang down to −1; ceilings are at height 3 in columns 4, 5 and 7, and height 2 in column 6. The complete load must stay strictly below each ceiling. Change aisles only at columns 3 or 8.
Deck height ranges from 1 to 5. Driving above height 2 adds sway; reversing adds 1. Raising loaded cargo adds 1; lowering reduces 1; Stabilize reduces 3. At 8 sway the lift topples. Match both cargo dimensions and aisle geometry. You have 115 actions.

Text description of the board

A LITTLE CAUSE. A LITTLE EFFECT.

Choose routes through a loop of phase doors, conserve one-use anchors and collect seals in their required materials.

Time advances only when you act. Take a breath and plan the next move.

Field notes
Collect three seals: (2,1) requires B, (6,1) requires C, and (10,6) requires A. Reach E at (10,1) in phase B within 110 actions. Coordinates start at zero. Each pair of neighboring chambers has two doors with different phase requirements.
A, B and C doors admit only their matching phase. On an unused o anchor, Change phase cycles A → B → C → A and consumes that anchor. A spent anchor becomes · floor. Start S and exit E can cycle repeatedly.
Plan the seal order and preserve an anchor for the return journey. Undo restores your previous move, phase, seals and consumed anchor, so a mistaken commitment can be reconsidered before the action budget is spent.
